{{Quote|Hey, my ship! Come back here!|The Quarren to Bane, Eval and Hardeen as they steal his ship|<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>}}
A '''[[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] owned an [[Unidentified HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class freighter/Legends|HCT-2001 ''Dragonboat''-class freighter]] parked in the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
After escaping from the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]], along with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] disguised as [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], stole this Quarren's ship to escape from Coruscant. However, the Quarren was looking at his [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and noticed his ship was getting hijacked a few seconds after takeoff.
